diagnosis.rationale: The undiluted readings stop increasing after about 7 h and hover near 0.64–0.67, a plateau/signature consistent with reader saturation rather than necessarily true cessation of growth. Direct checks of the retained 18 h aliquot contradict the undiluted value: at 10x dilution the mean reading was 0.2484, corresponding to OD 2.484 undiluted-equivalent; at 25x dilution the mean was 0.0997, corresponding to OD 2.493. The two dilution-corrected estimates agree closely and are about 3.9x the undiluted 18 h reading (0.6441), showing that the undiluted late-culture samples are outside the proportional range and substantially under-report biomass.
